title: Verify login button visibility on linkedin.com with implicit wait
preconditions: Implicit wait is set to 10 seconds
testSteps: Locate the login button on the page
expectedResult: The login button is successfully located and is visible on the page within the 10-second implicit wait window.

title: Verify login button visibility with explicit timeout handling (Recommendation)
preconditions: Simulate a delayed network or rendering condition
testSteps: Wait for the login button to appear using the 10-second implicit wait limit
expectedResult: The test correctly identifies the login button if it renders within 10 seconds or throws a Timeout/NoSuchElement exception if it exceeds 10 seconds.

title: Verify login button presence under restricted network conditions (Recommendation)
testSteps: Navigate to https://www.linkedin.com under throttled network
Check if the login button becomes visible within the 10-second implicit wait timeframe
expectedResult: The login button renders and becomes visible within the 10-second implicit wait despite the slow network.

title: Verify behavior when implicit wait is insufficient for slow loading elements (Recommendation)
preconditions: Implicit wait is set to a value lower than required (e.g., 1 second) while page load is artificially delayed
testSteps: Attempt to locate the login button
expectedResult: A NoSuchElementException is appropriately thrown when the element does not appear within the allotted wait time.
